title: Leave a group
summary: Leaves a group after a confirm that says what happens. The last admin is asked to choose a new admin first; the last person is told the group ends.

case.description: lastPerson: nobody else is joined or invited. lastAdmin: the person is the only member with power level 100 and others remain.

phase.description: pickAdmin: lastAdmin picks a member to become admin. leaving: Room.leave runs.

ask.effect: From the group info: works out case from the members and power levels and opens the confirm.

pickAdmin.effect: Room.updatePowerLevelsForUsers gives the member power level 100, then leaves.

leave.effect: Room.leave, then Room.forget so the group goes from the list on every device. Back to the Groups tab.

notes: A DM never shows leave: it shows Apagar conversa (dm-delete, ADR 0141).
Leaving does not delete messages for the others.
